_description: Attribute-level override controls for ML feature selection. Each attribute may have force_include or force_exclude set to override automated pipeline decisions. 'reason' is required when a force flag is set. Source: 1 sample S1 and S2 scene catalog. These defaults apply when no date-specific override exists.
_override_rule: force_include=true overrides any automated exclusion. force_exclude=true overrides any automated inclusion. Both flags being true is invalid — exclude wins.
notes: Set force_include/force_exclude to true/false with a reason string to override pipeline decisions.
